{{Top|leg}}
The '''advanced droid interface''' was a self-contained artificial intelligence module that was equipped on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for the purpose of providing additional resources useful in the bypassing of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and security systems. This module increased the capabilities of the droid to a level typically seen on military espionage droids.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
